limitations: Fair-odds returns do not establish realised profitability.
Only the five explicit Bet365 mappings can support historical actual-bookmaker subset returns.
HT/FT realised historical return is not measurable from current data.
Failure reasons overlap and are non-exclusive; rejected candidates are not a one-per-match strategy.
All intervals are unadjusted despite multiple group, check and exploratory-market comparisons.
No optimal group, rule or filter is selected from observed returns.

methodology.actual_odds: Optional exact Bet365 pre-match priced-subset returns only. No average, closing, similar-market, synthetic-margin or Mozzart substitution. Missing mappings/prices produce no actual-return claim.

bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile CI; dates resampled with replacement; ratio of summed returns to summed selections
bootstrap.multiple_comparisons: Intervals are unadjusted across all groups, checks and exploratory markets.

methodology.calibration: picker.json season_factors fitted on seasons before each target season by picker_backtest; the target season's mapping only is applied. 2019-20 has no fitted factors and uses 1.0.
methodology.coverage: Covered/eligible settleable fixtures. Rejected diagnostics also report rejected/eligible candidates.
methodology.htft_exploratory: Every visible HT/FT-group market is reported separately, including combination/double-chance members. These are secondary exploratory multiple comparisons, not confirmed strategies.
methodology.interpretation: Fair-odds return is model-price accounting, not realised profit. Landed approximately equal to predicted supports calibration only. Ranked, Strict and rejected cohorts differ in composition; their contrast is descriptive and not a causal paired comparison. No cohort is selected as best.
methodology.numeric_precision: Unrounded internal probabilities, matching the existing TYPE_RULE backtest. The live round JSON rounds pc to four decimals; fair-return calculations here do not use the two-decimal fair-odds display string.
methodology.probability: Displayed pc = raw goals-model p x target-season group/band calibration factor, clipped to [0.001, 0.999]; fair odds = 1/pc. Raw p is used only for t4 agreement.
methodology.ranked: One highest-pc visible candidate per match per group; single market keeps every eligible fixture; pc descending.
methodology.settlement: Flat one-unit stake; fair profit = fair - 1 when landed and -1 when lost. Unsettleable selected rows are excluded.
methodology.small_sample_rule: Flagged when selections < 200 or contributing round dates < 30; descriptive caution, not a significance test.
methodology.strict: TYPE_RULE exactly; one highest-pc passing candidate per match per group; single market keeps every passing fixture.
methodology.strict_rejected: Every settleable visible group candidate failing at least one TYPE_RULE check before one-per-match selection. Candidate-level diagnostic only; not a selected-pick cohort.
methodology.walk_forward: For every division and Tuesday/Saturday/Sunday round, goals and empirical rates use only matches strictly before that date; at least 200 prior division matches are required.
